item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Looking for complete recordings of 2010 award shows
item.description:
Hello everyone,
I'm looking for complete recordings (full broadcasts) of these 2010 award shows:
American Music Awards 2010
MTV Europe Music Awards 2010
MuchMusic Video Awards 2010
ECHO Awards 2010

I'm not looking for individual performances. I'm hoping to find the complete broadcasts, including:
Opening sequence
Red carpet (if available)
Host segments
Artist introductions
Acceptance speeches
Full live performances
Backstage segments
Commercials (optional)

These shows were a big part of my high school years, and I'd love to preserve and revisit the 2010 pop music era.
Does anyone know if complete recordings still exist in a private collection, archive, or any legitimate source?
Any information would be greatly appreciated.
Thank you!
